title: Kaitei Daisensou (Japan) V1.004 music preload
summary: Preserve timed, complete-read-guarded preload in the Japanese source.
rationale: Optional exact-source profile. Retain the original music preload and exact complete-read guard. The Japanese routine is at 0600A2D4; the second pointer at 060044E0 targets its copy hook at 0600A310. The flag is at P2 2600A33C. Requires the existing sector reader at 02000F04. This does not fix the separately deferred intermittent SMPC freeze.

writes.effect: Install preload, copy and a clear flag in the Japanese loader span.
writes.reason: Replace the existing routine without changing its caller.

writes.effect: Redirect the second music call to the guarded copy.
writes.reason: Preserve timing and skip copies after incomplete reads.
